texts.value: Functions as a receptor binding protein (RBP) and mediates the attachment to the host capsular exopolysaccharides (PubMed:35130876). Displays a lyase activity that specifically degrades the K1-type polysaccharides of Klebsiella pneumoniae capsule (PubMed:25001459, PubMed:35130876)
Belongs to the K1-specific depolymerase family
